caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table-like object with four cylindrical legs and a rectangular top. The surface of the table is divided into two distinct sections: the left side contains a recessed, grid-like area framed by wooden slats, while the right side is a flat solid plank with visible wood grain and two round wooden plugs. Below the left section of the tabletop, there is a single rectangular drawer, which has a dark-colored handle affixed to its front. The wood throughout the drawing appears to be a light to medium brown color, with noticeable natural variations in shade and grain. The background is a plain, off-white color with no other objects or details present.
title: Shoemaker's Bench
